items.title: Mercedes F1's drivers still get the final say, even as it utilizes AI agents
items.summary: Toto Wolff, Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team Principal and CEO and Judson Althoff, Microsoft (MSFT) Commercial Business CEO, join Yahoo Finance's Deirdre Bosa to discuss the scale of AI and compute behind the Mercedes F1 team, including more than 10 million race-day simulations and millisecond-level collaboration between remote analysts, the pit garage, and the driver.

items.title: Did Microsoft AI Partnership Just Shift Danaher's (DHR) Investment Narrative?
items.summary: Danaher announced a partnership with Microsoft to build AI assisted, cloud based scientific instruments and lab software, with early tools such as MetaXpress Acquire AI Assistant already moving toward commercial rollout. The push toward an interoperable agent platform suggests Danaher is trying to embed its hardware more deeply into customers’ workflows, which could reinforce recurring software and consumables usage over time. Now the focus shifts to how this AI centric tie up with Microsoft...
